Product_Analysis.definition: Deconstruction of the product into features, benefits, and USPs.

Target_Audience.definition: The specific group of consumers most likely to purchase the product.

Market_Context.definition: The competitive landscape and current trends affecting the product.

Source_Credibility.definition: The reliability of the information source.
Source_Credibility.rules: Official product pages > Reputable Tech Blogs > General Forums

goals: Identify the single most compelling selling point.
Provide actionable insights for the creative team.
constraints: All claims must have a cited source URL.
Avoid marketing fluff; focus on verifiable specs and user reviews.
Data must be recent (within last 2 years unless historical context is needed).
